messages:
ana (partnerships): Heads up: EdgePartner wants to launch apac-west-3 marketplace SKU this week. They need quota (nodes), a published SKU, and legal sign-off. Can we triage?
li (edge-partner): We can provide 4 x A800 nodes. Target steady qps 1.5k, p95 ~65ms. Need SKU + billing test.
ken (cloud-sku): For marketplace we need entitlement JSON, price band, and partner billing contact. We can create SKU same day once entitlement is in.
omar (infra): Ops: need VPC peering, healthchecks, and canary routing. Suggest 10% canary for 24h. Also need seq len and KV hit rate for sizing.
li (edge-partner): Avg seq length 150 tokens, KV hit ~20%.
julia (legal): Confirm they accept our standard MSA? If yes, we only need region addendum. That speeds things up.
li (edge-partner): Yes, standard MSA ok. We'll sign addendum.
an a (partnerships): Action list: (1) Li: send entitlement JSON + billing contact (2) Ken: create SKU after entitlement (3) Omar: prep canary config (4) Julia: draft addendum.
onboard-bot: Checklist created: marketplace/1872345678-edgepartner-apac-west-3. Items: entitlement, SKU, quota, legal, billing test.
ken (cloud-sku): Please send entitlement to sku@redwood.com.
li (edge-partner): Sent entitlement and billing contact finance@edgepartner.ai.
omar (infra): I'll open infra PR for canary and peering today.
julia (legal): Draft will be in Drive: /legal/partner-addendums/edgepartner-apac-west-3. ETA tomorrow morning.
ana (partnerships): Thanks everyone, will follow up in thread. :thumbsup:
